items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: And we took every number with Lewis Song, put on the record, like Connett, Chop, Suey, and everything... and we got them records

ctx.x: And we took every number with Lewis Song, put on the record, like Connett, Chop, Suey, and everything, I just can't think of all them things at present, and we got them records
